answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on one ferrous ledge and files a whisper fingerprint, its quiet check-in rhythm, hashed and sealed. Each epoch the auditor replays a fresh slice against the filed pattern; a reused or rented rhythm burns the bond. First 35, the k-th 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. A rented-fingerprint ring fails: one rhythm fits one ledge. Honest agents whisper once, keep their bond.
